questions.explanation: The Japanese word benri, written 便利, means "convenient" and functions as a na-adjective. Building a reliable word-to-meaning link is the basis of reading comprehension, and it is strengthened by seeing the word in several contexts rather than as an isolated gloss.
questions.hint: Recall the na-adjective benri and the idea "convenient" it expresses.
